visual.general_description: Six-panel grayscale figure of two chest radiographs (A, B), two axial chest CT slices (C, D) and two axial abdominal CT slices (E, F).
visual.detailed_description: Panels A and B are frontal chest radiographs with burned-in header text and masks at the top. Panels C and D are axial chest CT slices in black frames with scanner overlay text; C shows a bright curved vessel beside the tracheal lumen and D shows large bright mediastinal vessels with branching hilar vessels. Panels E and F are axial abdominal CT slices without printed text; E shows a large homogeneous organ and F shows both kidneys. Panel letters A to F are printed in white at the upper left of each panel. No arrows, outlines or measurement marks are printed anywhere in the figure.

Both lung fields are visible with rib shadows; the lower thorax is lighter and the image is soft and low in resolution. Small text fragments run down the left margin and the bottom-left corner. No arrows, circles or measurement marks are printed.
